title: DashboardAuthoringResponse
description: 200 response body of POST /api/authoring/dashboard (HEL-392, extended by HEL-397) — a schema-valid DashboardProposal grounded in the caller's real workspace and validated via the same checks DashboardProposalService.apply uses. The proposal is NOT applied by this call — applying stays the caller's explicit, separate action via POST /api/dashboards/apply-proposal.

warnings.description: Degrade-not-fail notices collected while assembling the grounding context (e.g. a per-DataType panel-capability fetch that failed) — never a reason the call itself failed. Always present, possibly empty.

conversationId.description: HEL-397: identifies the persisted conversation this turn belongs to — pass it back as the next call's conversationId to continue refining the same proposal. Present on every successful response, including a fresh single-shot call (turn 1 mints a new conversation as a transparent side effect).

authoringRequestId.description: HEL-401: a fresh id minted per successful call — distinct from conversationId (which identifies the CONVERSATION; this identifies THIS specific authoring REQUEST). Forward it to Proposal Review so a later accept/reject can correlate back to this outcome via POST /api/authoring/requests/:id/outcome.
